## Trigger Conditions

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Set the oracle threshold to a value between 1 and the publisher count.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let pub1 = Address::generate(&f.env);
let mut pubs = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
pubs.push_back(pub1);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_set_oracle_config(&f.governor, &pubs, &2, &3600));
```
